About

Behind the Code – My Story

GJD

Gaddangi Jaman Dora

Paderu, Visakhapatnam

I'm Gaddangi Jaman Dora, a technology enthusiast from Paderu, Visakhapatnam. My journey combines technical education, creativity, continuous learning, and a passion for building useful digital solutions.

I completed my ITI Fitter qualification and recently started my Forward Deployed Engineering learning journey at Aarohan with Fynity Innovation.

I believe technology becomes powerful when it solves real-world problems. My goal is to develop practical software solutions, collaborate with talented teams, and continuously improve my technical knowledge.

My Journey into Forward Deployed Engineering

Recently, I enrolled in a Forward Deployed Engineer course at Aarohan with Fynity Innovation Institution, Pedabayalu Campus. This journey is helping me understand how technology can be applied to real-world business problems through software engineering, frontend development, backend development, AI tools, and collaborative project development.
